scene_diversity.status: DESIGN SUPPORT CHECKED; NOT PROVEN INDEPENDENCE

hierarchical_logic: Essential constructability -> physical variation -> independent support -> joint support -> overlap/confounding -> proxy regimes. No aggregate score. Thresholds are declared project choices; final recommendation remains research judgment.
limitations: Observational metadata cannot establish fusion degradation, backfire, causal attribution or a normalization law.
Clusters are nested and dependent; counts are not an effective independent sample size.
Projection uses keyframe box position and camera-time ego pose; native object displacement is not compensated.
Metadata visibility is not per-camera occlusion; LiDAR support is a provided count, not recomputed raw sensor quality.
Velocity is a finite-difference estimate, not instantaneous ground truth; edges, gaps and annotation noise matter.
Physical-width proxy ignores rotational image motion and orientation-dependent image scale.
Pooled mismatch coverage does not transfer to every class/dt. In vehicle.car, 50 ms has no r>=1 observations; see class-conditioned coverage.
Physical size is semantically confounded: the middle-width bin is dominated by vehicle.car. Use within-class comparisons and observed overlapping support, not pooled size effects.
CAM_FRONT projected scale is valid only on its geometric-FOV subset; near-plane rejection and partial image boundaries create selection. Large unclipped box envelopes are not visible object widths.
Distance and LiDAR point support are dependent (descriptive pooled Spearman about -0.652); control observation quality when comparing geometric regimes.
Relative lateral motion is strongly influenced by ego translation and is not equivalent to moving-object speed. Ego rotation needs a separate axis or a full projection-based model.
Rare semantic classes do not share the broad pooled support. Emergency ambulance and some mobility classes cannot support the same broad claims under the configured design thresholds.
supported_claims: All structurally essential requested variables are constructible on the full official 850-scene trainval split; object/relative velocity remains missing on 4,405 annotations rather than imputed.
Distance/lateral-motion comparisons have broad scene and trajectory support: all nine global tertile cells meet the declared project support rules.
Within-class coarse comparisons can hold distance/width approximately fixed while lateral motion varies, and conversely; overlap is evidence for designing comparisons, not a causal estimate.
A class-conditioned temporal perturbation study is feasible. For vehicle.car, 100–200 ms supports all four specified physical-proxy bands; 50 ms is a lower-mismatch control axis.
Native sensor offsets are predominantly camera-dependent with additional scene variation and outliers; actual timestamps should define future perturbations.
unsupported_claims: An existing fusion failure/backfire boundary, accuracy degradation curve, or validated cross-scene normalization law.
Uniform large-mismatch coverage at 50 ms for vehicle.car, or pooled coverage generalized to all semantic classes.
Causal separation of size, motion, distance and sensing quality from a correlation matrix or coarse quantile matching alone.
Treating 1,166,187 annotations as independent trials, or treating counts of trajectories/scenes as a formally estimated effective sample size.
Interpreting camera FOV projection as unoccluded camera visibility, or physical width W as an orientation-independent projected width.
Treating the 0.5 s first-order proxy or finite-difference velocity as exact instantaneous geometry.
recommended_next_step: Proceed with a restricted experimental design, not automatic full sensor acquisition: start with well-supported classes such as vehicle.car and adult pedestrians; prespecify distance × lateral-motion strata within class and width strata, balance visibility/LiDAR support, and separate high-yaw scenes. Use 50/100/200 ms initially, with 500 ms as a clearly approximate stress test. Reserve held-out scenes (prefer also log-level separation), cluster summaries by trajectory/scene, and check clipped versus unclipped camera scale before testing normalization. Download only the sensor subsets needed for that prespecified design, then obtain explicit authorization for GPU/BEVFusion deployment. Current evidence does not require switching to Waymo/AV2; supplement only if a targeted unsupported class/regime or external generalization claim is required.

thresholds.notes: All support, motion, yaw and dependence thresholds are configurable project design diagnostics, not scientific laws. Quantile ties collapse rather than splitting identical values. Mini never yields a final suitability decision.

projection_scale_evidence.note: Unclipped 3D-box envelopes can exceed the image width; not all projected widths are suitable observed object scales. 1600 is the metadata image width used by these nuScenes camera records; this diagnostic is not a rejection rule.

research_review.decision_basis: Broad constructability/joint/independent support, but class/dt restrictions, sensing-quality dependence and geometric approximations prevent unrestricted claims.
